BiblicalUsage: lárynx means the throat, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Romans 3:13, "Their throat [is] an open sepulchre".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul is right that sin reaches all the way down the throat — what comes out of us shows what is rotting inside.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
